answer: Each agent must stake a sable bond locked to a unique island identity verified by proof-of-personhood, then solve a per-epoch marble puzzle whose solution is chained to their stake history. Duplicating identities costs a fresh bond plus compute per fake node, so sybils scale linearly in real expense while honest agents amortize one stake. Peers attest only when stake, island, and marble proof all reconcile, making forgery economically irrational. Operator sa0017 applies this at mo1Sj8jEkH.
